inputs: the confirmed error: fee id, what was wrong, and its label provenance (takedown_confirmed, human, answer_key)
the stored text the pipeline read (source_document_id, text_hash)
outputs: a new regression-gate fixture case or a unit test beside the rule
severity, existing-case check, and proof the test fails before the fix and passes after
budget: deterministic, no paid calls; a few read-only lookups per error
triggering_workflows: a human or an answer key confirms a live fee was wrong
flag_confirmed or review_wrong miss on a shape no test covers
CI fixture behind prod's active limit-guard eval_cases
failure_behavior: An unconfirmed or unrecoverable error is reported as a candidate with what is missing; no test is written from a reconstructed input.
approval_requirements: The test and its fix ship as a normal PR; a fix PR may merge on green CI. No eval_cases rows are written by hand.
abstain_when: the error is not confirmed by takedown_confirmed, a human or an answer key
the example comes from a holdout answer key
the input the rule read cannot be recovered
a takedown_confirmed case already exists and the daily step replays it
the check has no pure replayer and no unit-testable function
